nativeCPUFallback.scope: One fresh native CPU process with exact saved reference input, no cache purge; functional fallback check, not full app latency.

applicationProbe.workload: Single user-provided RAW developed locally to a 2048 by 1365 sRGB preview
applicationProbe.scope: Actual PicEdit worker including installation checks and final raster. Result cache disabled; new model object per request. Installation validated the model before these requests. RAW decode and diagnostic PNG writes are excluded. OS/Core ML/GPU caches not flushed; process RSS includes setup and excludes some driver memory.

userInterface.placement: Bottom leading corner of the fixed photo viewport
userInterface.appearance: Compact material capsule with native activity spinner and accessible cancel button; static hourglass when system requests reduced motion.
userInterface.lifecycle: Visible only for the current source-bound mask request; hides after success, failure, cancellation or source/session change. Native work may retain its admission after UI cancellation; late results cannot publish.
userInterface.reduceMotionVerification: Production environment read reviewed; no global accessibility setting or unsupported environment override used by tests.

verification.testHarnessCorrections: macOS SDK exposes reduced-motion environment as read-only; static accessibility text can expose AXValue instead of AXLabel. Test assumptions corrected, final test runs pass.

limitations: One photograph and one host; no general six-second guarantee. Initial request remains slower than subsequent requests.
1920 and CPU fallback pass the existing numeric gates but are not pixel-identical to Float32; maxima remain explicitly reported.
No ground-truth alpha or Lightroom-equivalence claim; thin mixed foreground/background edge colors can remain under strong darkening.
Historical qualification.json and resolution-experiments.json remain unchanged as records preceding 1920 promotion.
privacy: No photograph, derivative, filename, local path, image hash or alpha hash included.
